Organic Inputs and SHMI+

Source: vignettes/articles/OrgInputs.Rmd
OrgInputs.Rmd

Organic Amendments as a Bonus; Grazing Animals as Diversity

Overview

SHMI 1.0 scored organic inputs as a fourth weighted sub-index, the share of years with an organic amendment or grazing animals. Because it was weighted, a field without manure or animals scored 0 on it, which read as a penalty for management that is often out of the farmer’s hands. Organic inputs now enter in two places:

  • Grazing animals are part of the field’s living system, so they raise Diversity (see the Diversity article).
  • Organic amendments (manure, compost) bring in carbon from outside the field, so they raise SHMI to SHMI+.

Both terms close a share of the gap to 100, so no score can exceed 100, and a field without amendments or animals is simply not raised.

1. Years with amendments and with animals

For each management unit ii, over the calendar years of its evaluation window, from rot_start_yr to rot_end_yr:

  • pamend,ip_{amend,i}: the share of years with at least one amendment of category "Organic" (SA_cat), dated by SA_date;
  • panimal,ip_{animal,i}: the share of years overlapped by a grazing period, from AD_start_date to AD_end_date. A period without an end date counts in its start year only.

Only presence is scored, not amounts.

2. The amendment bonus and SHMI+

Amend_bonusi=0.60pamend,i(100−SHMIi)SHMI+i=SHMIi+Amend_bonusi \text{Amend\_bonus}_i = 0.60\,p_{amend,i}\,(100 - \text{SHMI}_i) \qquad \text{SHMI+}_i = \text{SHMI}_i + \text{Amend\_bonus}_i

Equivalently, SHMI+=(1−0.6p)SHMI+60p\text{SHMI+} = (1 - 0.6p)\,\text{SHMI} + 60p: an amendment every year moves a unit 60% of the way from its SHMI to 100.

SHMI Amendments every year Half the years
40 +36 (SHMI+ 76) +18 (58)
60 +24 (84) +12 (72)
80 +12 (92) +6 (86)

The bonus is largest where management alone scores lowest. In the calibration data, the soil-health gain from amendments within sites also shrank as SHMI rose, though not significantly.

3. Where the 0.60 and 0.25 come from

The sub-index weights were fitted with the amendment bonus in place, so SHMI+ is the calibrated score. Held-out fit was flat for amendment shares from 0.5 to 0.8 and grazing shares from 0.25 to 0.5; 0.60 and 0.25 were chosen within those ranges. For sites held out of the fitting, SHMI+ explained 26% of the differences in soil health and SHMI 23%.

Interpretation

  • Report both scores. SHMI is the field’s own plant and tillage management; SHMI+ adds carbon brought in from outside.
  • SHMI+ = SHMI: no organic amendments in the window.
  • Amendments and SHMI do not trade off one-for-one: a well-managed field gains less from manure than a poorly managed one.

Output

compute_orginput_components() returns one row per management unit:

MGT_combo p_amend p_animal p_any n_years
… 0–1 0–1 0–1 years

build_shmi() returns SHMI, Amend_bonus and SHMI_plus, with p_amend and p_animal. compute_orginput() still gives the SHMI 1.0 score, 100pany100\,p_{any}, for code written against SHMI 1.0.
